## Summary
This video provides a comprehensive guide on using ChatGPT to engineer high-quality cinematic prompts for AI video generators like Runway and MiniMax. It introduces a specific framework focusing on the subject, scene, and camera movement to transform simple text descriptions into professional-grade video content.

## Key Points
- Effective video prompts must define the medium, subject, motion, scene environment, and specific camera settings.
- Using ChatGPT as a 'Prompt Engineer' allows users to automate the creation of detailed, cinemagraphic language.
- The 'Subject-Scene-Camera' framework is the core pillar for generating realistic AI video.
- Image-to-Video techniques generally provide more control and higher quality than Text-to-Video by establishing visual context first.
- Unified aesthetic prompts can be used to maintain visual consistency across multiple shots for filmmaking.
- Advanced workflows involve using ChatGPT to generate both a Midjourney image prompt and a Runway video prompt simultaneously for maximum consistency.

## AI Concepts
Prompt Engineering, Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, Generative AI, Consistency Modeling, System Prompting
